controller.title: Controller
controller.body: This notice covers IDLE Arcade, including the preview at idle-arcade.craftingservices.de. Contact the controller using the details above for privacy questions or to exercise your rights.

hosting.title: Hosting, delivery and security
hosting.body:
We operate the game on German infrastructure provided by netcup and Index Hosting. These hosting providers may access data as needed to provide their services and act as processors under Article 28 GDPR where required.

Connections involve IP addresses, timestamps, requested resources, HTTP status codes and browser information. Technical server and error logs support secure operation and troubleshooting. We also use IP-based counters held in server memory to limit login and registration attempts (counting windows: five minutes for login and one hour for registration).

Delivery and use of the game rely on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Abuse prevention and operational security rely on Article 6(1)(f); our legitimate interest is a secure, functioning service.

account.title: Registration and login
account.body:
A game account requires a chosen username and password. Please use a pseudonym where possible and avoid information about others. We store the username, internal account IDs, a password hash, and creation/update timestamps. The password is processed for verification but is not stored as a plain-text account password.

The authentication library also uses a technical placeholder email address generated from the username with the .invalid ending. We do not ask for a real email address or send messages to this placeholder. Session records include an ID, session token, expiry/creation timestamps and, where available, IP address and user agent.

This enables account registration, login and account association under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Required credentials are necessary to create an account. The current prototype does not yet store game progress or provide public leaderboards. We will update this notice when these features are added. There is no automated decision-making producing legal or similarly significant effects.

storage.title: Cookies and browser storage
storage.body:
The authentication library sets technically necessary session cookies, including better-auth.session_token, potentially prefixed with __Secure- over HTTPS. The regular session lifetime is seven days and may be renewed with continued use. Logging out ends the current session.

Local browser storage holds the language under idle-arcade.language and, after your choice, the analytics preference under idle-arcade.analytics.v1. Language persists until changed or cleared. The analytics choice expires after 180 days; analytics then stays off until you consent again. Session storage holds idle-arcade.onboarding-dismissed until the browser tab session ends to remember that you closed the introduction. When storage is blocked, choices may only apply in the open tab.

These storage operations provide the requested login, language and interface behavior and manage your privacy choice (Section 25(2)(2) TDDDG). Associated personal-data processing relies on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR for login and Article 6(1)(f) for preferences; our interest is to honor your choices. Rybbit itself sets no analytics cookies in this integration.

analytics.title: Optional usage analytics with Rybbit
analytics.body:
Only when you explicitly consent and confirm that you are at least 16 do we send usage data to our self-hosted Rybbit instance at ry.idle-arcade.craftingservices.de. Only then does the game load the Rybbit tracking script from that instance. No analytics requests are sent without consent. You can register, log in and play without consenting. This version does not offer a parental-consent analytics flow for under-16s; please leave analytics off if you are under 16.

We use analytics to understand how the game and the introduction are used, to find errors and to improve the service. We record page views including navigation within the game, clicks on links to other websites (target address and link text), completion or skipping of the introduction with a fixed step name, and JavaScript errors occurring in the game (error message, stack trace, file, line and column). Each event contains the hostname, the page path including URL query parameters, the page title, the referring page (referrer), screen size and browser language. To filter out automated visits, the script checks browser properties locally (such as user agent, window size, automation features and graphics rendering) and transmits only the resulting bot score. The connection also exposes the IP address, user agent and timestamp to the analytics server. From IP address and user agent, Rybbit derives approximate location and device information and a pseudonymous visitor ID, which lets visits be associated with each other, including across days. Being cookieless does not by itself make this anonymous.

We do not send usernames, account IDs, passwords, session tokens or form inputs to Rybbit and do not link analytics to your game account. Session replay and click, copy and form tracking are switched off. The script sets no cookies. It may store a random visitor ID under rybbit-visitor-id in local browser storage; it is not sent with analytics events in this setup and is deleted when you withdraw consent or your consent expires. Only authorized project members may access the analytics dashboard.

The legal bases are Article 6(1)(a) GDPR and, where device information is accessed, Section 25(1) TDDDG. Withdraw consent at any time with the switch below; the page then reloads to stop the tracking script. The login checkbox is hidden while consent is valid. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of earlier processing. Declining does not affect the game.

retention.title: Retention and deletion
retention.body:
Account data is retained while the account exists and is needed to provide it. Request account deletion using the email address above; there is currently no dedicated delete button. We delete associated personal data unless legal retention requirements or a specific need to defend legal claims prevents this.

Sessions have the validity described above; technical database entries may remain until cleanup. IP-based counters exist only in memory and disappear no later than a backend restart. Logs are retained only as needed for troubleshooting and security, or until an investigation into a specific security incident is complete. Backups are overwritten through backup rotation; deletions must be reapplied following a restore.

Rybbit usage events have a planned retention of 30 days. Analytics must only be enabled once that period is configured and verified on the self-hosted instance. Withdrawal stops further events and does not automatically request deletion of existing data; contact us to request deletion.

contact.title: Contact and recipients
contact.body:
When you contact us by email or telephone, we process the contact details and content you provide to handle your request. Article 6(1)(b) GDPR applies to account or contractual inquiries; otherwise Article 6(1)(f) applies based on our interest in responding. Requests are deleted after handling unless continuing duties or legitimate evidentiary needs require retention.

Data is accessible only to people and technical providers who need it for the stated purposes, and to authorities where legally required (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR). No transfers of game or analytics data outside the European Economic Area are planned for this deployment.

rights.title: Your privacy rights
rights.body:
Subject to GDPR conditions, you have rights of access (Article 15), rectification (16), erasure (17), restriction (18) and portability (20). You can withdraw consent at any time for the future (Article 7(3)).

RIGHT TO OBJECT: Where processing relies on legitimate interests under Article 6(1)(f), you may object on grounds relating to your particular situation (Article 21).

You may complain to a supervisory authority (Article 77), particularly where you habitually live, work or suspect an infringement. The authority for the operator in Hagen is the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information North Rhine-Westphalia (LDI NRW).

welcome.title: Welcome to IDLE Arcade!
welcome.description: IDLE Arcade is a room-based idle arcade. Each room is planned to offer a different game. The room navigation shows which rooms are available and which are still locked.

darts.title: Start with Darts
darts.description: Darts is your first available room. In the planned Darts game, you will be able to earn coins. The room is currently a placeholder while gameplay is being developed.

progression.title: Upgrade & Unlock
progression.description: Planned progression will let you use earned coins for upgrades and unlock more rooms as you advance. Upgrades, progression, and room unlocking are still being developed.
